instructions.value: Participants indicated the pointing direction of an arrow. In stop trials, they had to cancel the prepared or ongoing action when the blue stop signal appeared.

stimuli.value: A fixation cross and a left- or right-pointing arrow positioned to the left or right of the cross, both encircled by a white ellipse; in stop trials the ellipse turned blue after a stop-signal delay.
